subject: Procurement reboarding: renewal, 40% capacity uplift & portal evidence cadence
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Clark <sarah.clark@novabio.com>, procure@novabio.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Oct 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement reboarding: renewal, 40% capacity uplift & portal evidence cadence

Hi Sarah / Nova procurement team,

Thanks again for the recent usage call — great to see API traffic trending up. Per our discussion, Nova is set to renew on 2029-11-01 and you'd like to add a 40% capacity uplift on top of the current committed slots. To keep procurement simple, here's the proposed path:

- Sign SOW v2 (attaching a redline-friendly PDF).
- Submit PO using the attached PO_template_Nova.xlsx.
- Complete a short reboarding bundle in your procurement portal so we can reissue credentials and update SLAs.
- Provide SOC2 evidence (we included latest attestation) and point us to the portal ticket so our onboarding team can complete the re-certification.

I've attached Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf, PO_template_Nova.xlsx and SOC2_Attestation_2029.pdf. I've also included Jonas (account) and Kimberly (legal/ops) to help clear any contract or portal gating items. Can you confirm the portal contact and an expected PO date? If helpful, we can do a 20-minute procurement walkthrough this week.

Next steps (suggested):
1) Sarah / procurement: confirm ticket ID in Procure portal and PO ETA.
2) Nova: upload PO + SOC2 evidence to portal (or reply here).
3) Redwood: once PO accepted, we’ll schedule the credential reissue and apply the capacity uplift with a target effective date of 2029-11-01.

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Account Lead, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

-----
From: Sarah Clark <sarah.clark@novabio.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@novabio.com, Michael Brown <michael.brown@novabio.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Oct 2029 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement reboarding: renewal, 40% capacity uplift & portal evidence cadence

Hi Mateo — thanks for the clear checklist. We opened ticket #4582 in our portal this morning (link: https://procure.novabio.com/ticket/4582). Michael from procurement is looped in; he’ll coordinate the PO.

Quick questions from my side:
- Does the 40% uplift require a new commitment term or can it be appended to the existing master with a short addendum?
- We’ll upload SOC2 evidence to the ticket; is the 2029 attestation you attached sufficient for our security review?

We can do a walkthrough on Thursday at 10am PT if that works for you / your ops folks.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Clark
Head of IT Procurement | Nova Biosciences

-----
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Clark <sarah.clark@novabio.com>, procure@novabio.com
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Oct 2029 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement reboarding: renewal, 40% capacity uplift & portal evidence cadence

Thanks Sarah — Thursday 10am PT works for the walkthrough. On the two questions:

1) Contract handling: we can do this either as a short addendum to the current MSA (preferred for speed) or a fresh SOW + updated term if legal wants a separate amendment. Kimberly, can you confirm the simplest path for a US-based customer to accept a capacity uplift with minimal procurement friction?

2) SOC2: the 2029 attestation is what our security team expects most customers to accept; if Nova’s internal panel requires a gap, let us know specifics and we’ll route additional artifacts.

Action: Sarah / Michael upload PO and SOC2 to ticket #4582. Mateo and I will be on the walkthrough to confirm portal steps and timeline.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

-----
From: Michael Brown <michael.brown@novabio.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Sarah Clark <sarah.clark@novabio.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Oct 2029 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement reboarding: renewal, 40% capacity uplift & portal evidence cadence

Team — we plan to route the PO next week. A couple of internal notes so Redwood can prep:
- PO will reference the existing MSA (2028 version) and include an addendum line item for the 40% uplift tied to the Nov 1 effective date.
- We need a brief procurement-friendly summary of what will change operationally (credential rotation window, any expected downtime, billing cadence).
- Can Redwood accept our standard PO numbering? We will issue PO# NB-2029-1073.

I’ll upload the PO and SOC2 evidence to the ticket by next Wednesday (10/23). If anything needs to be redlined in the SOW, flag it beforehand.

-Michael
Michael Brown
Procurement Manager | Nova Biosciences

-----
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Michael Brown <michael.brown@novabio.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Oct 2029 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement reboarding: renewal, 40% capacity uplift & portal evidence cadence

Michael — appreciate the heads up and the PO number. A few confirms from legal/ops side: 
- We can accept PO# NB-2029-1073 and apply the uplift as an addendum to the active MSA. No full MSA re-execution required.
- Operational changes: credential rotation will occur during a 30-minute maintenance window; no expected downtime for token-based API calls, but clients performing model hot swaps should expect a brief cache-warm period (~2 minutes).
- Billing cadence: uplift will be pro-rated for November and reflected on December invoice as a single line item.

I’ve also uploaded a short procurement summary doc to our internal Drive and will share the link in the walkthrough. Once Nova uploads the PO and SOC2 to ticket #4582, ops will queue the credential reissue and we’ll confirm the effective uplift timestamp.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Contracts & Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

[Attachments referenced above: Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf; PO_template_Nova.xlsx; SOC2_Attestation_2029.pdf]
